name: org_graph_declare_structure
description: Give a unit a structure of its own, from effective_on (today by default): unit types only the units beneath it use, while the unit itself keeps its type. Every unit beneath it changes type in the same change, by conversion, which names a new type for each type held there. copied_from is "top" or a unit with a structure of its own, when the types copy that structure's. Refused, naming them, for units that wouldn't fit, a unit an HRIS supplies beneath it, a unit that already has a structure, and a date after today or before a change beneath. org_graph_withdraw_structure undoes it. Needs a tenant admin, an Org Graph editor, an owner of the unit or a unit above it, or anyone they report to.

name.description: unique within the structure, ignoring case

parent_names.description: types in this structure it can sit under; name the type itself to let it nest

top.description: whether it can sit directly under the unit; true by default

copied_from_level_id.description: the type it copies, in the structure copied_from names

levels.description: the structure's unit types, top first

conversion.description: each level_id a unit beneath holds => the name of the type in this structure it becomes
